# Snapshot index

One row per committed snapshot under `reports/snapshots/`. F6 (WB-5.1) requires every snapshot
README to open with a machine-read header recording the pinned `toolkit.lock` value AND the
suite checkout's git SHA (`toolkit.lock:` / `suite-sha:` lines). Without both fields a score
change cannot be attributed to a toolkit change vs a suite change (CQ-5), so the header check
in `test/snapshot-index.test.ts` is a hard gate. Regenerate this file with
`node scripts/snapshot-index.mjs`; the same command with `--check` fails when it is stale.

## Score deltas by toolkit.lock SHA

No cross-toolkit.lock deltas yet: every committed snapshot pins the same `toolkit.lock` value (or only one snapshot exists), so CQ-5 has no toolkit-vs-suite attribution to report. The next snapshot whose `toolkit.lock` differs from a predecessor appears here as a per-cell score delta table.
